findings.claim: CRYPTO_CLOSE cannot run a short-side plan: execution.execute refuses side='short' unless entry_price == 'open' (execution.py:414-416), so any E4-style short plan under market='CRYPTO_CLOSE' raises ValueError. findings.evidence: execution.py:414-416: `if cfg.side == "short": if cfg.entry_price != "open" or cfg.fill_model == "C": raise ValueError("the short side is defined for open entries (US, crypto profiles)")`; E5_CEILING_protocol_draft.json family.side == "long".
findings.fix: No code change required in the owned files. Add one line to the profiles.py comment (or the E5 protocol notes) stating the variant is long-only and fill-model A, so no one plans a CRYPTO_CLOSE short sensitivity.
